description: Read Franc-Tireur, the weekly, from Claude: site articles, issue contents, search and readable PDFs.
long_description:
Reads Franc-Tireur with your subscriber account: articles from franc-tireur.fr (paywalled ones included), the contents of each issue, site search, and the printed edition from the digital kiosk (liseuse) as a readable PDF.

Setup:
1. In Google Chrome (or Arc, Brave, Edge), sign in to https://www.franc-tireur.fr with your subscriber account. For the printed edition, also open https://digital.franc-tireur.fr and sign in there.
2. In Claude, ask: "who am I on Franc-Tireur?". The first time, macOS asks whether `security` may use the "Chrome Safe Storage" keychain item: type your Mac password and click Always Allow. This is how the extension reuses your browser session; nothing is sent anywhere else.

The site session lasts about a day: if Claude says the paywall refused the session, reload franc-tireur.fr in Chrome and ask again. PDFs, pages and issue archives are saved in Downloads/franc-tireur.
